metadata.description: Haazel multi-archetype site factory — 7 skills that turn any domain (or net-new brief) into a production-grade Next.js site across cinematic, SaaS, app, lead-gen, commerce, and editorial archetypes, with tokenized design systems and optional Sanity CMS auto-blogging.

plugins.name: haazel
plugins.description: Multi-archetype site factory. Seven skills: /haazel-build (the orchestrator — phased workflow with approval gates), /haazel-brand-analyzer (live-DOM brand extraction), /haazel-design-system (tokenized design system generation), /haazel-design (section-level design surgery), /haazel-assets (provider-abstracted asset pipeline), /haazel-cinematic (GSAP motion system), /haazel-auto-blog (Sanity CMS + auto-blogging).
